findings.detail: The exact v1.22 acceptance contract at ADC_TOP_Design.md:443-445 and 461-469 requires non-vacuous pre-edge raw-marker capture, P0/P1 first-pair coordinates, terminal15 registered-request to next-edge FIFO sampling exactly once, loss on that pending-request sample edge retaining the one committed request while creating none, same-edge FIFO_CLR cancellation, and separate DDC retained-queue/committed-loss-edge and clean-no-pending cases. The frozen TB still labels its scheduler model v1.15 and _region_coordinate_trace explicitly samples only POST_EDGE state; it contains no pre-edge tuple assertion or exact request/sample-edge scoreboard. The DDC recovery stimulus drops afe0_rx_reset_done at FallingEdge(adc_clk), not at an AFE pending-request sample edge, asserts only the clean FIFO-empty abort behavior, and never proves retained pre-abort queued data, a committed loss-sample request, or same-edge FIFO_CLR cancellation. verification_manifest.json likewise declares only the older generic v1.15/DDC-empty coverage, and the raw evidence contains REGION_COORD POST_EDGE/DDC_RECOVERY markers rather than the required edge outcomes. Therefore the observed VMware 16/16 PASS is semantically insufficient for v1.22 and the baseline cannot advance to READY_FOR_VCS. Add explicit A9/A10/A11 tests and manifest tags, rerun VMware verification, and refresh the release evidence/drafts before fresh independent review.

residual_risks: Deterministic release-baseline verification, role separation, hashes, source ownership, lint integration, and in-memory finalization-patch simulation pass; the semantic-coverage blocker prevents acceptance and the patch must not be applied.

Static audit found the corrected decimation/DDC f2 region formulas, two-beat buffers and mapping, raw marker use, registered FIFO request/clear precedence, DDC fail-closed recovery, CDC/reset ownership, PUB/ADI provenance boundary, and EXTERNAL_ONLY constraint classification consistent with the finalized design; no separate RTL functional blocker was identified.
validate_rtl_style.py returns the expected RTL_STYLE_DELTA_REVIEW_REQUIRED for MODIFIED_THIRD_PARTY_RTL; manual owned-RTL naming/format review found no release blocker.
MODEL_EQUIVALENCE remains NON_VENDOR_EQUIVALENT; VCS/Verdi, Vivado/XSIM, synthesis, implementation, timing closure, bitstream, and board validation remain NOT_RUN, and PPA remains HYPOTHESIS.
